title: Indian Cyber Regulation Register
description:
Every cybersecurity and data-protection instrument binding Indian regulated entities, with its reference number, issue date, status and the dates it sets. Covers the RBI, SEBI, IRDAI, PFRDA, IFSCA, CERT-In and MeitY. Every entry is read from the issuing regulator's own notification, and each record carries the date that source was last re-read.

This is a dated snapshot. The live version is at bitscore.in/resources/india-cyber-regulation-register, with the files at bitscore.in/data. Indicative reference data, not legal advice.
